source: Assam's five revenue divisions (Commissioners of Lower, North, Central, Upper Assam and Barak Valley) with the 35 LGD districts of 2026; district lists written by hand, then checked 2026-11-15 against the GAD 'Divisions' page (https://gad.assam.gov.in/divisions, undated, older than 2022): 33 of the 35 districts match (Karimganj = Sribhumi); Bajali and Tamulpur (made in 2022 from Barpeta and Baksa) are not on that page and stay in Lower Assam (unchecked). The offices of the Divisional Commissioners were abolished in July 2023 (cabinet 2023-05-19; India Today NE 2023-07-17, Sentinel 2023-08-04; the notification text was not found): the divisions have no current head, and the commissioners on the GAD page are former post holders
